text:
jordan: quick alert from a scheduled SAST+DAST sweep on staging — found an authorization bypass pattern around header parsing for /api/v2/submit. low volume but reproducible.

tara: can you share the minimal repro and which build? staging is running the new rbac-split branch.

jordan: repro curl below + zap snippet link: https://paste.redwood.internal/ci/3392100000. Correlation-id: stg-xc4f.

```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.test/api/v2/submit \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <stg-token-readonly>' \
  -H 'X-Assert-User: role=admin' \
  -d '{"item":"probe"}'
```

sam: looks like `header_assertion` path set role without checking token scope. I landed the RBAC change that split token vs header precedence (PR 4599). tagging @chen for audit logs.

chen: filing SEC ticket. Need affected commit SHA, KMS decrypt events during the window, and any ephemeral RBAC grants. Also request that middleware emit `audit.event=header_assertion` when it happens.

sec-bot: [SCAN-ALERT] SAST/DAST combined policy triggered HIGH - auth-bypass on /api/v2/submit. Ticket SEC-1249 created.

tara: mitigation: flip ALLOW_HEADER_ASSERTION=false in staging and add unit test to require `scope:assert-role` for header asserts. Jordan, can you rerun the harness after flip?

jordan: flipping flag now and will re-run.

sam: I'll prepare a quick PR that adds the audit event and a metric for header-assertion-count.

jordan: re-run done — no repro after flip. uploading evidence bundle to SEC-1249.

chen: setting retention for artifacts to 90 days and exporting KMS audit logs to the ticket. Also adding compliance tag.

tara: assign to sam for PR and to chen for evidence. I'll coordinate postmortem and timeline.

jordan: thanks folks — will follow up in ticket with timestamps and logs.
